name: bakeblisscafe
description: Bake Bliss Café - Handcrafted cakes, pastries, and artisan coffee

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function cp(s,d){if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()){if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).forEach(c=>{if(!['dist','build','node_modules','.git','bakeblisscafe-build.zip'].includes(c))cp(path.join(s,c),path.join(d,c))});}else{fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(s,d);}} cp('.','dist'); cp('.','build'); console.log('Build generated in dist/ & build/ folders!');"
